citation: Doar, W.R., III, 2013, Geologic Map of the Plantersville Quadrangle, Georgetown and Horry Counties, South Carolina: South Carolina Geological Survey Open-File Report OFR-165, map scale 1:24,000.
notes:
Single map sheet read from OCR (page 1). Map symbols recorded only where printed directly below a description (QHfw, Qe, QPps; flagged inferred); garbled symbols ('QHfim', '[ aFpas |') were not recorded. The Water unit was not recorded. Legend-only features (contact, drill-hole symbol) were not recorded as values. Two values printed with '|' for a digit are read as 1, flagged inferred and sent to review.
SUBSURFACE: margin elevations: Holocene terrace sediments below 10 ft landward; Princess Anne Formation above 12 ft seaward, below 18 ft landward; Pamlico Formation above 17 ft seaward, below 25 ft landward (page 1). Princess Anne estuarine/marine unit: lower part 10 to 20 ft, upper part 1 to 10 ft thick (page 1). The legend shows SCGS drill-hole locations with log identification numbers (e.g. 22-411), logs on file at the SCGS and not in this document (page 1). No cross sections or structure contours appear in the OCR text. Datum: the base map line reads '1973 North American Datum' in the OCR; the vertical datum is not stated (page 1).
Re-read of page 1 for subsurface fields (single OCR map sheet). Units as before; map symbols read from the legend boxes on a page-image tile (OCR had 'QHfim', '[ aFpas |'). Two values printed with '|' for a digit read as 1 (inferred). Margin elevations (Holocene terrace sediments <10 ft landward; Princess Anne Formation 12/18 ft; Pamlico Formation 17/25 ft, seaward/landward) recorded as contacts and as stated unit tops at those margins (boundary inferred; no vertical datum printed). Whole-page image checked: no cross section or structure contours; SCGS drill holes (22-4xx) plotted by label only, without depths (logs on file at SCGS). Water unit and legend-only symbols not recorded.
